parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of an ECS or SLB instance in the VPC.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the authorization. The name must be unique.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number that corresponds to the instance.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC. The VPC must be an available one that belongs to the same account as the API.

parameters.name: VpcTargetHostName
parameters.description: The host of the backend service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi set-vpc-access --name test --vpc-id vpc-uf657qec7lx42paw3qxxx --instance-id i-uf6bzcg1pr4oh5jjmxxx --port 80 --description VPC_description --vpc-target-host-name iot.hu000ng.com --tag Value=123 Key=key --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi SetVpcAccess --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --Description VPC_description --VpcId 'vpc-uf657qec7lx42paw3qxxx' --InstanceId 'i-uf6bzcg1pr4oh5jjmxxx' --Port 80 --Tag.1.Value 123 --VpcTargetHostName 'iot.hu000ng.com' --Name test
